fusions.name: Tine in the Straw
fusions.desc: A quick jab that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Blind-Side Thrust
fusions.desc: A thrust from where it was not looking that deals 28 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Blades in the Leaves
fusions.desc: Takes 1 second to bury a blade under raked leaves at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles sets it off: it deals 22 damage in a blast around it.

fusions.name: Edge Kept Keen
fusions.desc: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your crit chance rises by 30% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.
